provenance: Author self-review renewing evidence after the Shared nominal-kind revision. Read the complete required authored units, exact selected declarations/implementation/tests and policy; shared identical inputs were read once across packets. Inspected supporting example-state and embedding definitions and evidence helper code in retained source context. Compared statements, assumptions, examples and rejection boundaries with the prose; did not treat hashes, compilation or prior approvals as a substitute for this comparison.
rationale: Comparison for unit:shared.embedding against lean:Correspondence/UniqueShared:embedId, lean:Correspondence/UniqueShared:embedReference, lean:Correspondence/UniqueShared:embedSlots, lean:Correspondence/UniqueShared:embedObject, lean:Correspondence/UniqueShared:embedState, lean:Correspondence/UniqueShared:embedPlace, lean:Correspondence/UniqueShared:embedValue, lean:Correspondence/UniqueShared:embedStatement, lean:Correspondence/UniqueShared:embedClasses, lean:Correspondence/UniqueShared:embedProgram, lean:Correspondence/UniqueShared:embedConfiguration. The embedding maps every object reference to unique, preserves absent slots, table order, identities and counter, recursively translates gives/constructors and never produces giveShare. embedClasses now explicitly uses classType, so declaration kinds retain Given construction behavior. The scope is single-variable bindings; the separate typed fragment handles unpacking. Notation and judgment context was checked in unit:given.classes, unit:given.state, unit:given.syntax, unit:given.unpacking, unit:shared.state, unit:shared.syntax.
limitations: Author self-review, not an independent fresh reviewer.

Lean checks proof correctness separately. Tooling review checks implementation and finite test coverage, not universal correctness or browser/CDN behavior. Additional context keys identify supporting definitions inspected in those files, not an audit of every proof or line.
